form.pw.title: Ask for password
form.pw.on: A dialog asks for the SSH password each time you start it. Nothing is stored, and it never starts or restarts by itself.

form.auto.title: Start automatically
form.auto.on: Starts when the shell starts and the network is up.
paste.ok: Filled in from the ssh command. Check it, then save.
paste.note.bind: It listens on 127.0.0.1 only: the wider bind address was not used.
paste.note.more: Only the first -L was taken: one tunnel is one forward.
paste.err.unsafe: Paste just one ssh command, without ; | & $ or backticks.
paste.err.notSsh: That does not look like an ssh command.
paste.err.option: The option %1 cannot be used here. Put it in ~/.ssh/config and use that Host as the SSH server.
paste.err.port: SSH port %1 is not supported here. Put it in ~/.ssh/config and use that Host as the SSH server.
paste.err.command: There is something after the host. Paste only the ssh -L part.
paste.err.noHost: No SSH server found in the command.
paste.err.noForward: No -L forward found in the command.
paste.err.forward: Cannot read the forward "%1". It should look like [bind:]port:host:port.
